review.official:
The Rhodes Island Recon, composed of the Felyne Masamune and the Canyne Yoshitsune, takes its name from the unit they belonged to back home in Kamura Village—the 'Buddy Recon.' Masamune and Yoshitsune had already received professional training in intelligence investigation and material gathering, and had spent a long time honing their skills in Houei. As such, they immediately began playing important roles in all manner of missions the moment they joined Rhodes Island. They want to find a way home, but they are also quite enthusiastic about adventuring on Terra, so they have adapted to life here fairly well.
The lively, friendly Masamune quickly became a star among the Operators—many Operators applied to go on missions with Masamune simply to see the adorable talking 'cloudbeast,' while the originally aloof Yoshitsune has also hit it off with many Operators who are passionate about combat.

The Rhodes Island Recon, composed of the Felyne Masamune and the Canyne Yoshitsune, takes its name from the unit they belonged to back home in Kamura Village—the 'Buddy Recon.' Masamune and Yoshitsune had already received professional training in intelligence investigation and material gathering, and had spent a long time honing their skills in Houei. As such, they immediately began playing important roles in all manner of missions the moment they joined Rhodes Island. They want to find a way home, but they are also quite enthusiastic about adventuring on Terra, so they have adapted to life here fairly well.
The lively, friendly Masamune quickly became a star among the Operators—many Operators applied to go on missions with Masamune simply to see the adorable talking 'cloudbeast,' while the originally aloof Yoshitsune has also hit it off with many Operators who are passionate about combat.

Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory systems and there is no sign of infection. At this time, the two operators are believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Masamune and Yoshitsune show no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

When the concept of a 'hunter' came up in conversation with the members of Team A6, Masamune's usual liveliness faded, replaced by a certain seriousness, and Yoshitsune, who had been dozing off to the side, pricked up his ears.
In their homeland, Hunters are charged with protecting the ecosystem as they hunt monsters. Thus, every hunter is a forerunner who explores the unknown. 'The Fierce,' for example, was the great hero who resolved Kamura Village's crisis—the 'Rampage.'
'All great hunters share one trait: a never-give-up spirit!'
No matter how troublesome the enemy, and no matter how many times they fail, true hunters will keep challenging their quarry until they win, or until they fall. As Masamune describes it, a 'hunter' is not only a profession, but also a symbol of a certain spirit.
'That sounds like the furthest thing from our squad,' Spot could not help but say.
'Yeah, I think so too. I'm not anything that impressive. I just think it's fun,' Catapult chimed in. A never-give-up spirit? She certainly did not think her reason for picking up the charge blade was that noble.
But Masamune shook his head.
'If this were before, I might have thought the same. But things are different now. Whether it's the people of Houei or the people of Rhodes Island, only the opponents they fight and their reasons for fighting are different from hunters! Everyone has that never-give-up spirit!'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Orchid tells of hunting meownsters known as 'paperwork' on the daily. You hunt them as well, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Yoshitsune, do mew remember how the Buddy Plaza looked? Yes, just a whisker of ink here—good, another chapter done! Deliver it to Spot for purr-usal! Ah, there really is no better way to reminisce than by illustrating the true tails of our homeland. How sharp Spot was to suggest this!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Having known Her Meowjesty Hofukaru, I'll say that Popukar is nothing alike! At first, the way she stared at me, I feared I'd offended her—my nights were sleepless! Eventually, I balled up the nerve to ask her, and lo and behold, she just wanted to pet me! We're such good friends meow, we even share the same bed!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, fur-give us! Yoshitsune almost clobbered Midnight in training! He briefly mistook the man fur our indomitable Shogun, and his reflexes kicked in—ah, not to imply your Midnight's a kitten in mittens, certainly not!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Catapult's gone again? I'll join Orchid in tracking her down! What? Yoshitsune, do you mean to stop me?! Purr-posterous, you're on Catapult's side?! So be it! It's mew or me! Let's duel!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You want to learn the way of the Wirebug, Doctor? Very well! See the silk it secretes from its rear? Grab onto that, then aim in your desired direction, and throw—holey socks, the Doctor's gone flying! Quick, Yoshitsune, get ready to catch!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Mreep?! Mew'll be late for a meeting? Yoshitsune—Doctor, Yoshitsune's telling mew to get on! Now, word of warning, he's a fast runner, maybe too fast for your constitution—oh dear, and they're gone. Yes, I hear the Doctor caterwauling already. Oh well, I'll just have to deliver some medicine.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Yoshitsune, that's my tail you're lying on… mrow? Oh, it was the Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Felicitations! We are Masamune and Yoshitsune of the Kamura Village Meowcenaries! Reconnaissance, material gathering, just leave it to us! Phew—compared to the bungled introduction we gave Her Meowjesty, that was perfect!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That's right, every hunter worth their stripes has their own approach to combat!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hunting? Recon? Just leave it in our paws!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: It's purr-ime time to show what we're made of!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Begin quest!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Doctor, Yoshitsune's caught the enemy's scent!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yoshitsune says the enemy's prowling nearby!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Stay, Yoshitsune, stay!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is a job fur us!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's find intel and materials to give the Doctor fuzzy feelings!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Feast on eight paws' worth of Meowcenary might!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Leave 'em chasing their own tails!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You almost hit me, you fur-brain!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: We'll purr-loin good materials this time, I can feel it!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What purr-fect command of such a hair-raising mission! You're as fine as the hunters of legend, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What rare materials did we get this time? I'm itching to know!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, stay vigilant! We still have enemies meowt and about!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Cart's good to go! Whisk the Doctor out of here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I wonder who's got the bigger steelworks? Rhodes Island, or Kamura Village?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Mrr-rauders?! Oh, it's mew, Doctor!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You have some impawssibly complex contraptions aboard Rhodes Island…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Yoshitsune, you feel it, don't you? Ten years since we left Kamura Village, and we still haven't settled who's really top dog. Hmph! You're not the only one who's gotten stronger. Today's the day! This snowball fight decides which of us—CATAPULT! I'LL NIP YOU FOR AMBUSHING ME!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! Meow's the time for a hunt!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, as a token of a-purr-eciation for looking after us, Yoshitsune and I made you a portion of super-sumptuous Kamura-style Bunny Dango! It's a refinement on Yomogi's secret recipe, guaranteed to fill you with so much pep, you could work for nine lives straight! You what? You'll pass on it? Pardon?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It seems the 'curse' that spread across Houei exists on Terra too. If we can furst figure out the secret of that 'curse', it's paw-ssible we might find a way home again! Think about that, another trip to Houei! It'd blow Popukar's party away to meet their own selves, I'd bet my tail on it!
